terminal_growth.name: terminal_growth
terminal_growth.rationale: Below long-run nominal GDP growth, per the g<3% constraint enforced by the engine.

risk_free_rate.name: risk_free_rate
risk_free_rate.rationale: Use the 10Y US Treasury yield on the valuation date. Record the date.

equity_risk_premium.name: equity_risk_premium
equity_risk_premium.rationale: Mature-market ERP. Damodaran publishes a monthly implied series.

unlevered_industry_beta.name: unlevered_industry_beta
unlevered_industry_beta.rationale: Bottom-up: unlevered beta of the peer group, not a regression on Uber's own stock.

debt_spread.name: debt_spread
debt_spread.rationale: Spread over risk-free implied by Uber's credit rating or its actual issuance yields.

country_risk_premium.name: country_risk_premium
country_risk_premium.rationale: JUDGEMENT, NOT A DERIVATION. Note 13 gives US 21,429, UK 8,373, all other 14,176 - 32 percent of revenue sits in an undisaggregated bucket whose per-country split is not disclosed. State a premium and say what mix you assumed and why.

share_price.name: share_price
share_price.rationale: Closing price on the valuation date, for market-weight capital structure.

discount_rate.name: discount_rate
discount_rate.rationale: NOT A VALUATION INPUT. Round-number rate used only to prove the pipeline runs end to end. Superseded once WACC is built bottom-up from the six components above.
